profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Creative, persistent, and enthusiastic worker always looking to acquire new skills and otherwise expand knowledge of computer science. Enjoy being involved and in both UX and UI development and have a passion for creating something from start to finish. Have worked with projects mainly involving React, Typescript, and JavaScript. Experience working in groups and with other professionals, good at meeting deadlines, and driven to learn more about relative subjects.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I have worked with various different teams at CDK and am currently working on a team which is focused on modernizing and enhancing our customer's experience when filing 1099s. Since joining the team we have successfully gone through our pilot and are now working on enhancements for our general release.

I am working with React and Typescript as a UI developer on the team. Along with the React Testing Library.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: During my time at CDK I have been working with two different teams. I am in charge of maintaining and adding features to a website I had previously helped design and build. I have also taken the lead on the UX design for a new internal website and learned how to use Sketch in the process. I am working with React as the primary UI developer for this project, and have worked closely with the architects on the team in order to better understand requirements so that we may provide a smooth experience for our users.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Worked on a team to build two web pages for internal company use in order to streamline and improve efficiency. Worked on the entire design process of the site, started out with sketches and discussed with the UX team about what might be the best way to proceed. Utilized React to create front end and used Python to start the automation process for the web page. Became familiar with Spring for API set up as well as mongoDB for databasing. Performed various professional presentations, strengthened technical writing skills, and improved critical thinking skills.

volunteerExperiences.description: Worked in organization of the data system in the Sutter Gould Medical Library. Also worked in the emergency department where I would organize the patients coming in for the nurses and doctors as well as calling them back and helping patients to their room. As well as assisting people signing into the lab and got their paperwork ready for flu shots.
Was in charge of the front desk directing people as well as taking calls and doing runs for different departments in the hospital.
